name: Applied Sol Theory
description: The outpost engineers built training simulators in the basement before the luddite attacks. Each one is calibrated for a different Sol ability. Now that you have a Sol Unit, it's worth running through them.

test_elevation.label: Test the Elevation Chamber
test_elevation.description: The first simulator tests elevation mechanics and the Hover Chip ability. Enter the chamber via the lower level of the outpost basement.

completionActions.text: Elevation mechanics checked. The Hover Chip opens new routes — vertical traversal is now available.

test_light_sentry.label: Test the Light Sentry Lab
test_light_sentry.description: The second simulator is calibrated for the Light Sentry Emitter — a deployable beam weapon that can reflect off mirrors and activate sensors.

completionActions.text: Light Sentry confirmed. Photosensor puzzles and beam mechanics are live.

test_pulse_cannon.label: Test the Demolition Range
test_pulse_cannon.description: The third simulator is the Demolition Range — built for the Photonic Pulse Emitter. It charges and fires a massive area blast capable of destroying cracked walls.

completionActions.text: Quest complete: Applied Sol Theory. All three training simulators cleared. Your Sol Unit knowledge is field-ready.
